subject: [PATCH 4/6] kernfs: don't take kernfs_iattr_rwsem to publish KERNFS_REMOVING

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch modifies the kernfs subsystem to remove unnecessary locking when marking a subtree as KERNFS_REMOVING. The lock was previously taken to prevent new usage of the subtree, but since the refresh no longer sets the i_nlink of directories being removed, the lock is not needed. The patch updates the __kernfs_remove function and the kernfs_dir_nlink function to reflect this change, resulting in a performance improvement of around 10-20% for certain workloads.
